question: Count the number of papers Stanford University had between 2000 and 2009.
schema:
tenant=spider_aan_1
tables:
  - Affiliation
      affiliation_id: int — affiliation id
      name: str
      address: str
  - Author
      author_id: int — author id
      name: str
      email: str
  - Author_list
      paper_id: str — paper id
      author_id: int — author id
      affiliation_id: int — affiliation id
  - Citation
      paper_id: str — paper id
      cited_paper_id: str — cited paper id
  - Paper
      paper_id: str — paper id
      title: str
      venue: str
      year: int
relationships (many → one; joins are added automatically):
  - Author_list.affiliation_id → Affiliation.affiliation_id
  - Author_list.author_id → Author.author_id
  - Author_list.paper_id → Paper.paper_id
  - Citation.cited_paper_id → Paper.paper_id
  - Citation.paper_id → Paper.paper_id
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.paper_id) FROM Paper AS T1 JOIN Author_list AS T2 ON T1.paper_id = T2.paper_id JOIN Affiliation AS T3 ON T2.affiliation_id = T3.affiliation_id WHERE T1.year >= 2000 AND T1.year <= 2009 AND T3.name ILIKE 'Stanford University'
system_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT al.paper_id) AS paper_count
FROM `workspace`.`aan_1`.`author_list` al
JOIN `workspace`.`aan_1`.`affiliation` aff ON al.affiliation_id = aff.affiliation_id
JOIN `workspace`.`aan_1`.`paper` p ON al.paper_id = p.paper_id
WHERE (
  aff.name ILIKE '% Stanford University %' OR
  aff.name ILIKE 'Stanford University %' OR
  aff.name ILIKE '% Stanford University' OR
  aff.name ILIKE '%Stanford University%' OR
  aff.name ILIKE '%Stanford University, %' OR
  aff.name ILIKE '%Stanford University;%' OR
  aff.name ILIKE '%Stanford University; %'
)
AND p.year IS NOT NULL
AND p.paper_id IS NOT NULL
AND p.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
